summary: Iteration-4: verified the server-authoritative consent hardening. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_consent_security.py (12 tests) + /app/backend/tests/test_choice_flow.py (2 tests) and re-ran the existing suite. Full pytest run: 30/30 PASS. All four SECURITY-CRITICAL forgery cases pass: forged consentText on add is ignored, forged consentText on POST /waitlist/{id}/consent is ignored (200, not 400), consent with no body / empty {} body works, and a backdated consentGivenAt (1970) is replaced by a fresh server timestamp. Frontend Playwright run on /dashboard/clinic_smile_dental_indiranagar confirmed the shown copy (consent-text, consent-panel-text-<id>, row-consent-text-<id>) is byte-identical to the persisted consentText for BOTH the 'Add with consent' path and the 'Record consent' path, and the add -> remove -> re-add-without-consent path stores nulls. /choice page smoke passed: both pills (submit-refund, submit-credit) measure exactly 220x52. No backend errors in supervisor logs. Test data cleaned; seeded waitlist restored to 4 consented + 2 non-consented.

minor.issue: Unknown body fields (consentText, consentGivenAt) are silently dropped by Pydantic rather than rejected. Behaviour is SAFE (verified stored value is always the server template), but consider model_config extra='forbid' so an integrator sending consentText gets a loud 422 instead of a silent no-op.
backend_test.py creates throwaway clinics/slots that are never deleted (34 slot docs accumulated in Mongo). Not user-visible, but the DB grows every test run.

issues: When a booking was fully covered by a priority pass (totalPaid=0) the page reads 'How would you like to receive your ₹0?' and offers a ₹0 refund / ₹0 credit. Copy should short-circuit for zero-value transactions. Reproduced only with a credit-redeeming transaction; low priority.

action_items: Optional: set extra='forbid' on AddPatientBody so forged consent fields 422 instead of being silently ignored.
Optional: teardown test clinics/slots created by backend_test.py.
Optional: handle totalPaid == 0 copy on the /choice page.
critical_code_review_comments: render_consent_text() in services/waitlist_service.py is correctly the single backend source of truth and is reused by seed.py, so seeded and runtime rows cannot drift - verified all consented rows (seeded + newly created) return the identical string.
record_consent(entry_id) takes no body at the route level, so FastAPI structurally cannot accept client text - the strongest possible form of this fix. Double-consent still correctly 409s.

consent.js and waitlist_service.render_consent_text are duplicated wording in two languages with only a comment linking them. Considering exposing the template via a tiny GET /api/clinics/{id}/consent-text and having the UI render from it, so the invariant is enforced rather than documented.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_-prefixed patients/slots/transactions created and deleted; priority passes purged. Seeded waitlist verified back at 6 rows (4 consented / 2 not).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Persistent suites: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (16), test_consent_security.py (12), test_choice_flow.py (2). Run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` (pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope - do NOT add -n/-p flags, they error). Broadcast counts must be asserted relative to non-TEST_ seeded rows, otherwise parallel workers make them flaky (test_broadcast_seeded_slot already does this). mock-pay requires a JSON body {"fireWebhook": true} and returns the txId under webhookResponse.transactionId. Clean up TEST_ patients + priority_passes after runs or clinic stats/pricing drift.
rca_of_the_issue: No defect found. The iteration-2 forgery vector is closed at two levels: AddPatientBody no longer declares consentText/consentGivenAt (values dropped before the service layer) and the consent route declares no body at all; both write paths call render_consent_text(clinic.name) and datetime.now(timezone.utc) server-side.
